output.sql: SELECT c.segment, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders o JOIN marts.dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY net_revenue_2025 DESC;
output.explanation: Revenue per customer segment for 2025 counts only completed orders (is_revenue = true), with net_revenue summed per segment from dim_customers. Orders are filtered to order_date within calendar 2025, which is the fiscal year. Shipping fees are excluded because net_revenue does not include them.
